title: Lambert W Function
subtitle: Special Functions · Inverse of xe^x
detail:
\[ W(x)\,e^{W(x)} = x \]

Principal branch \(W_0\ge -1\) defined for \(x\ge -1/e\). Used to solve equations like \(xe^x=c\), delay differential equations, and in combinatorics (tree-counting). \(W(e)=1\); \(W(-1/e)=-1\).
